page.layout: One column of running text, full width. No marginal notes. Below the last line, at the right, the catchword "Hambur-". Above the text, the page number and running head.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.l: fvorum hæreditate locuples ac potens,
ut est natura hominum, à magnis ad ma-
jora contendebat, & jus, quod multorum
erat, in se solum sensim trahebat, seque
summum prætorem per totam illam o-
ram haberi volebat: atque hanc ad rem
amicitia Hamburgensium, & Ailconis
Houwerdæi, & affinitate Grethanorum,
qui tum in Frisia Orientali supra reliquos
in Nobilitate eminebant, quorum erat
gener & sororius, abutebatur. Hinc fa-
ctiones vicinorum contra ipsum, & ini-
micitiæ mutuæ, interdum & injuriæ:
& ipse Eppo turbidior Groninganis, & so-
cietati eorum infestus, ac vicissim civi-
tatis animi non satis in eum placati:
videbanturque ad arma res tendere, cùm
inter Hamburgenses & Groninganos in-
ducia biennes sunt factæ. His induciis
durantibus pactiones illæ, de quibus dixi,
anno cccc.xxxv cum civitate initæ. At
induciis vixdum finitis incrudescere prio-
ra, Ailco & Eppo in cives aut socios
Groninganos injurii esse, & vicissim à
Groninganis pati, quæ nollent: Eppo
præcipuè, qui parte opum est ejectus

page.notes: The running head reads "Frif." in the header; the long s may be intended as "Frisf." or "Fris.", so it is marked as doubtful and kept as printed. The first word "fvorum" is printed "fuorum" and was changed to consonantal v per the u/v rule. "vixdum" and "vicissim" were read from the printed forms "viciffim" and "vixdum". The hyphenated line-end words "fa-ctiones", "in-ducia" and "prio-ra" keep their printed hyphens. No marginal notes are printed on this page. The digitiser's watermark at the lower right is excluded.
